newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P raises Colonial NZ claims rating after merger.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises Colonial NZ claims rating after merger.

text.p: Rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Monday it had raised the claims-paying ability rating on Colonial Mutual General Insurance Company (NZ) to AA- from A- following its acquisition by HIH Winterthur Insurance.

S&P said the rating change followed the announcement that CMG, the general insurance unit of Colonial Mutual Life Assurance Society, had been sold to Australian-listed HIH Winterthur Insurance, controlled by Switzerland's Winterthur Insurance Co, last week.

"The acquisition appears to be a good fit, with CMG's retail and small commercial focus and associated distribution network complementing HIH NZ's existing business of larger corporate/ commercial risks.
"In addition, a degree of operating efficiency is expected to be acheived from the merger of operations which should ultimately help profitability.
S&P noted that CMG's former owner had an A+ claims-paying ability rating.
